command: python benchmark.py --config configs/benchmark.json --output results/benchmark.json --variants prefixfold ungrouped torch_sdpa numpy_dense --timeout 120

protocol.timing_scope: compute_only; fixture creation and dense materialization reported separately
protocol.ordering: seeded shuffled variants within every warmup and measured round
protocol.memory: whole-worker process peak RSS including imports, setup, correctness and timed calls; not variant workspace
protocol.kv_payload: actual allocated K/V array bytes; excludes lengths, mask, output and workspace
protocol.throughput_unit: query_vectors_per_second (batch * heads / seconds); not generated tokens
protocol.data: seeded synthetic float32 normal Q/K/V; no pretrained model or real request trace
protocol.tail_latency: not claimed; 30 observations are insufficient for reliable extreme tails
protocol.thread_note: VECLIB_MAXIMUM_THREADS=1 requested; Accelerate enforcement is not observable through threadpoolctl
